craft_notes: Sthāyin vismaya (groundless picture). End-dash→colon: canvas opens directly onto hail. Rejected: 'hail!' exclamation — shout un-Sanskrit; kept plain hail. Read aloud: canvas spreads, hail answers.

lines: Stocked with nothing, backed by no wall, they unfurl the world-canvas:
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

reads_against.argmap: Provision without material; on no wall indeed, they extend the world-picture. → Bow to the trident-bearer extending the world-picture without ground.
c1_essence: Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: With no provision of material, on no wall at all, they spread the world-picture — bow to him, the art-praised trident-bearer.
l2.sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

l3: Stocked with nothing, backed by no wall, they unfurl the world-canvas —
reads_against.t1: Provision without material, on no wall at all, they extend — the world-picture: bow to him, art-praised trident-bearer.
